metadata.title: Cerebras Stock: Earnings Are Coming as AI Chips Enter a New Era<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Cerebras Set to Report Earnings as AI Chips Enter a New Era
Artificial-intelligence chip maker Cerebras Systems will report its second-quarter earnings on Wednesday afternoon, and it might be another volatile day for the stock on Thursday.
